_comment: Copy me, rename after the ride, fill in. Files starting with _ never render. Full field notes live in src/data/rides.js.
name: Ride Name
subtitle: The one-line hook under the title
_time: What the ride ACTUALLY took. Clock, H:MM, QUOTED — "1:45" shows as "1hr 45mins", "0:45" as "45mins". Unquoted 1:45 is invalid JSON and breaks the whole garage. null until ridden.
_estimateTime: What the route SHOULD take. Leave null — the detail page works it out from the router for the stops below. Set it (same format) only to override.
description: The short blurb on the ride card.
story: The write-up on the detail page.
_stops: Start → any stops to route through → end. Two or more puts the ride on both maps; fewer means no route to draw. `dir` is which side the pin's label sits on. `icon` is what kind of place it is — temple, home, office, showroom, restaurant, hotel, shop, beach, fuel, waterfall, fort, station… (full list: PLACE_ICONS in pages/GarageV7RideDetail.jsx). An emoji works verbatim. Omit it and the stop gets a lettered pin instead.
